AssessmentProgress.description: The progress values reported by the AssessmentProgress response element.

IndividualAssessmentCompletedCount.description: The number of individual assessments that have completed, successfully or not.

IndividualAssessmentCount.description: The number of individual assessments that are specified to run.

schema.description: Resource Type definition for AWS::DMS::ReplicationTaskAssessmentRun. Provides read-only visibility into an AWS DMS premigration assessment run, an ephemeral job started for a replication task via the StartReplicationTaskAssessmentRun operation.

AssessmentRunName.description: Unique name to identify the assessment run.

IsLatestTaskAssessmentRun.description: Indicates that the following premigration assessment run is the latest for the migration task.

ReplicationTaskArn.description: Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the migration task associated with this premigration assessment run.

ReplicationTaskAssessmentRunArn.description: Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of this assessment run.

ReplicationTaskAssessmentRunCreationDate.description: Date on which the assessment run was created using the StartReplicationTaskAssessmentRun operation.

ResultEncryptionMode.description: Encryption mode used to encrypt the assessment run results.

ResultLocationBucket.description: Amazon S3 bucket where AWS DMS stores the results of this assessment run.

ResultLocationFolder.description: Folder in an Amazon S3 bucket where AWS DMS stores the results of this assessment run.

ServiceAccessRoleArn.description: ARN of the service role used to start the assessment run. The role must allow the iam:PassRole action.

Status.description: Assessment run status. This status can have one of the following values: cancelling, deleting, failed, error-provisioning, error-executing, invalid state, passed, provisioning, running, starting, or warning.
